english:
DigiXross
combines
Digimon in a
special attack.
To use it,
learn a
DigiXross move
and keep all
required
Digimon in your
party. A
Digimon with
Paralysis,
Sleep,
Confusion, or
Blindness
cannot join a
DigiXross
attack.

english:
Choose Items to
use a
consumable.
Items can
restore HP or
MP, cure Health
Down effects
such as
Paralysis,
Sleep,
Confusion, or
Blindness, and
revive a KO'd
Digimon.

english:
Choose Tactics
for automatic
battle orders.
Full Power
picks the
strongest move
and a target
each Digimon
can defeat.
Conserve MP
chooses moves
with low MP
costs. Guard
focuses on
defense. Escape
tries to flee.
If even one
Digimon gets
away, the party
escapes.

english:

DigiXross, or
Items, your
Digimon return

default Tactic
next turn. The
icon shows
which Tactic:

Conserve MP,
Esc is Escape,
and Grd is

battles start
with Full
Power. Choose
another Tactic
to change your
default. Your
choice stays
that way
between
battles.
